remarks: Well maintained 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath Colonial in the heart of the Village of Albion! This home features low-maintenance vinyl siding and a wide-open, spacious kitchen with plenty of room to cook and entertain. Ideally situated within easy walking distance of local schools, neighborhood shops, and dining. A wonderful combination of space, charm, and village convenience. The additional attic rooms offer flexible space that could be used as a recreational room, home gym, office, or hobby area. Some updated windows provide added comfort and efficiency. The home features a Rheem gas furnace, stainless-steel appliances, and convenient first-floor laundry with a stackable washer and dryer. A versatile layout and thoughtful updates make this home a great opportunity for a variety of lifestyles.
